categories.main_business_segments: Jiawei Renewable Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in new energy power generation and photovoltaic (PV) consumer products. Its new energy power segment includes PV power station EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) and operation & maintenance services, PV power station investment and operation, and related commercial and industrial energy storage. The PV consumer products segment focuses on solar-powered LED lighting products such as solar lawn lamps, courtyard lamps, and low-voltage lamps, integrating solar cell technology with LED lighting.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages solar photovoltaic technology combined with LED lighting technology for its consumer products. It employs EPC project management for PV power stations, including design, procurement, construction, and commissioning. Production of PV lighting products follows a customized order model with partial outsourcing for assembly and packaging to improve efficiency. The company emphasizes R&D in energy-saving control circuits, intelligent dimming, waterproof structures, and integrated high-brightness solar lamps, supported by a strong patent portfolio and advanced manufacturing certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jiawei serves large retail chains and home improvement supermarkets primarily in Europe and the Americas for its PV lighting products. Its PV power generation business sells electricity to grid companies under power purchase agreements. The company also serves industrial and commercial clients with energy storage solutions. Key markets include domestic China and overseas regions such as Southeast Asia, Africa, and North America, with a focus on emerging markets with growing electricity demand and renewable energy adoption.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive PV power station projects across multiple provinces including Shaanxi, Shandong, Guangdong, Inner Mongolia, Anhui, and others. It has manufacturing and sales presence internationally, including subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Vietnam, Denmark, the USA, and other countries. Overseas sales account for a significant portion of revenue, especially in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiawei operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the photovoltaic industry. It is involved in EPC contracting and operation of PV power stations (midstream) and manufactures and sells PV consumer lighting products (downstream). The company procures key components like solar modules and inverters from upstream suppliers and integrates them into finished products and power generation projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in PV and LED integration, energy efficiency, intelligent control, and waterproofing. It invests in R&D to develop new products such as energy-saving control circuits, dimmable smart lighting, and modular lighting solutions. Strategic focus includes expanding overseas markets, optimizing project management for PV power stations, enhancing energy storage capabilities, and leveraging overseas manufacturing to mitigate tariff impacts. The company also emphasizes talent development and digital transformation in manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of photovoltaic lighting products and solar power generation. The power generation segment earns income by selling electricity to grid companies under power purchase agreements. The EPC segment generates revenue from contracting services for PV power station construction and operation. The company also earns rental income from industrial park leasing and receives government subsidies related to its renewable energy projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Jiawei positions itself as a leading domestic new energy company with significant scale, technological capability, and a comprehensive R&D and production system. It holds numerous patents and certifications, and maintains strategic partnerships with upstream suppliers. The company competes in both domestic and international markets, focusing on innovation and quality to differentiate itself amid intensifying competition and market challenges.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jiawei reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 489.9 million, a 42.6% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 276.99 million. The company experienced significant asset impairments, increased financing costs, and project delays impacting profitability. Despite the loss, the company maintains substantial total assets of around RMB 2.86 billion and continues investing in R&D and overseas expansion. Cash flow from operations remains negative but improved compared to the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiawei emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies, and integrated solutions combining solar PV and LED lighting to offer energy-efficient, customizable, and innovative products. Its international certifications and intelligent manufacturing processes ensure high product quality and reliability. The company leverages overseas manufacturing to reduce costs and enhance global competitiveness. Its comprehensive EPC and operation services for PV power stations provide customers with end-to-end renewable energy solutions, supporting sustainable development and energy transition.
